title: PositionVectorType
description: A 3D Cartesian position vector using right-handed (x, y, z) coordinates, in a caller-defined consistent length unit.

x.description: The x-axis (first Cartesian) component of the position.

y.description: The y-axis (second Cartesian) component of the position.

z.description: The z-axis (third Cartesian) component of the position.
